name: Skyworks Solutions
fiscalYearEnd: Friday nearest September 30 (FY2025 ended 2025-10-03; Q3 FY2026 ended 2026-07-03)
description: Skyworks designs and manufactures radio-frequency and analog chips (power amplifiers, filters, switches, and related analog and mixed-signal parts) that let phones, tablets, wearables, cars, industrial and infrastructure devices connect wirelessly. It is largely a one-customer-heavy business: Apple, through multiple distributors and contract manufacturers, was more than 10% of net revenue in each of the last three fiscal years, and three accounts made up 82% of receivables. FY2025 revenue was $4.09B (down 2%) with operating margin of 12.2%, down from 23.6% two years earlier. It has signed to merge with Qorvo (announced October 28, 2025), which would combine two of its closest named competitors.

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry as listed in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies), read 2026-10-01; industry group and industry are not shown there. SEC SIC 3674 (Semiconductors & Related Devices).

employees.note: approximately; more than 99% full-time; about 54% in Mexico, 24% U.S., 20% Asia, 1% Canada

businessLines.name: RF and analog semiconductors (single product business in the text read)
businessLines.how: Per-unit chip sales to phone and device makers after winning a design slot; revenue follows smartphone unit volumes, RF content per phone and Apple's program cycle.
businessLines.description: Mobile (smartphones, tablets, wearables) and broad markets (automotive, industrial, infrastructure, smart home); a revenue split between them was not captured.

whatsNext.text: Merger with Qorvo: each Qorvo share to receive 0.960 Skyworks share plus $32.50 cash; combined enterprise value about $22.0B at the Oct 27, 2025 close; closing needs regulatory and shareholder approvals; either party may terminate if not completed by April 27, 2027 (extendable to July 27, 2027 and October 27, 2027)
